descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Graffiti LA takes your spray cans to the walls every writer in Los Angeles knows.

FOUR LA PLACES
- VENICE BEACH: the Venice Art Walls on the sand at sunset. Free-standing concrete slabs covered in years of pieces, palms down the boardwalk, the Pacific breaking behind you, the pier wheel turning far up the coast and a banner plane going by.
- LA RIVER: down in the concrete channel at blue hour. Paint the giant piers of the 6th Street Viaduct under its glowing white arches, with the downtown towers lit up and a freight train rolling along the bank.
- ARTS DISTRICT: a warehouse yard on a gold afternoon. Painted brick, a steel roll-up shutter, a cinder-block wall, power lines overhead, a water tank on the roof, a taco truck with a queue and a helicopter circling the skyline.
- MELROSE AVE: the pink wall and the stucco shop walls off the avenue on a blue morning, palms climbing to the Hollywood Hills, and a lowrider that pulls up and hops.

THE CITY IS ALIVE
People stroll the boardwalk, queue for tacos, take selfies at the pink wall, sit at cafe tables and stop to photograph your work. Traffic, trains, the surf and the city hum keep LA moving around you.

PAINT IT
Eight CITIVIEW spray cans, skinny, medium and fat caps, 32 stencils including A to Z, real mist and drips on 20 walls of concrete, stucco, painted brick, cinder block and steel shutter. Take a photo of your piece and switch places from the menu.
